os-dev-report 6511915566 `open_questions`: none. Every deviation and every cited open item, answered:

The line reads "landed 2026-10-29 … Still open: the acceptance run on the cloud `plugins/connector-stripe` sample (objectstack#27570)". Judged against Prime Directive #10 (declared ≠ enforced): the capability the ✅ declares — install, boot-time re-verification, tier dispatch, disable / enable / uninstall — is built and pinned (`install.integration.test.ts`, `uninstall.test.ts`, `installed-plugins-boot.test.ts`, the three slice records PASS); what is not done is the end-to-end run on the cloud sample, and the line says so by number. The alternative — leaving "Steps 4–7 do not exist" and "Not yet built" on `main` — is the falsehood. **Right, with the disclosure; the ✅ is not a full acceptance and does not read as one.** "landed 2026-10-29" holds: #27335 merged 2026-10-29T01:43Z, #27374 2026-10-29T11:57Z, #27679 2026-10-29T18:48Z.

- **Attribution block before the lane line** — harness-written HTML comment, the recorded exemption; PR body only.

Verified by reading both texts.

### ④ Design judgment

The ADR against its first consumer (the M1 slices: #27335 install + trusted-key store, #27374 boot-time loader + disable / enable / uninstall, #27679 bundled-only build + native-addon refusal), its execution plan (#27108 M0–M3, §4) and the ruling it records (6467932167, B′). Every sentence the diff writes, read against the cited code on `f5dd05758`:

- **Status line.** "M1, the local T0 install loop (2026-10-29, §3.5: `os plugin install ./x.osplugin` against the environment's trusted keys, the boot-time loader with the tier dispatch point, disable / enable / uninstall; its cloud-sample acceptance run is still open)" — each clause holds (`install.ts` header steps 1–6; `installed-plugin-loader.ts` header checks 0–5; `disable.ts`, `enable.ts`, `uninstall.ts`; #27570 open). "Not yet built: the cloud fetch (M2), runtime enforcement of the granted set (registered only today, §3.7 — M2), tier dispatch beyond `node` (M3), publish-side scans and secret-refs (M3)" — consistent with §3.5 M2, §3.7 v2, §3.6 v2 and §4. **Holds.** Should-fix (prose): the amendment list "(§3.3, §3.4, §3.5, §3.6, §7)" omits §3.2 (the L159 packaging comment) and §5 (the L602–603 risk), both edited by this diff; the status line is the ADR's own changelog and should name all seven.
- **§3.2 L159** `// bundled, the one strategy (see §3.3)` — `PluginPackagingSchema = enumWithRetiredValues(['bundled'], PACKAGING_RETIRED)` (`manifest.zod.ts:258`). **Holds.**
- **§3.3 bundled bullet.** "since M1 `os plugin build` refuses one before writing anything (a `.node` module or a native package the bundle reaches, or a `.node` file under `assets/`)" — `build.ts:271` esbuild `write: false`, `:303` `findNativeAddons(metafile, cwd, assets)` and the exit-1 refusal at `:304–313`, `computeIntegrity` at `:316`, the only writes at `:331–332`; the three signals are the header's step 3 and `findNativeAddons` (`.node` in the graph, `binding.gyp` / `gypfile: true` / shipped `.node`, `assets/*.node`). **Holds.**
- **§3.3 RETIRED bullet.** "`PluginPackagingSchema` accepts `bundled` only and refuses `manifest-deps` by name with its migration prescription; the build-side half was removed in M1 (#27679)" — `manifest.zod.ts:238–258`; `build.ts` header step 2 and `:259–275` (`external: ['@objectstack/*']`, everything else inlined). **Holds.**
- **§3.4 step 2.** "Since M1 the host verifies it against the environment's trusted keys (§7) at `os plugin install` and again at every boot (`verifyPluginArtifact`); `plugin-loader.ts` refuses a signature no host verified" — install: `install.ts:220` `readTrustedKeys`, `:254` `verifyPublisherSignature` over the raw bytes; boot: `installed-plugin-loader.ts:341` `verifyPluginArtifact` with `requirePlatform: false`; `plugin-loader.ts:519–556` reads the WeakMap verdict (`plugin-artifact-verdict.ts`) and throws on a signature with no recorded verdict for that exact string. **Holds.** Observation, no finding: the parenthetical names the loader's function; install calls `verifyPublisherSignature`, which `verifyPluginArtifact:283` wraps — as placed (after "at every boot") it reads right.
- **§3.5 step 5 *v2*.** "nothing is installed there; `bundled` is the one strategy (§3.3), so install runs no package manager" — `install.ts` steps 1–6: verify, read, re-verify integrity, lock, materialize, record; no package-manager call anywhere in the file. **Holds.**
- **§3.5 "Steps 4–7 exist for a local artifact only (M1, below; step 7's per-plugin enforcer is M2, §3.7). For a code plugin in the cloud they do not: nothing serves the `.osplugin` back (§3.4)…"** — `install.ts:117` takes a file path only (`Args.string`, "Path to the .osplugin artifact"); §3.4 L242–245 (unchanged) still records the download route as M2; §3.7 v2 (unchanged) still records `SecurePluginContext` as M2. **Holds** and is internally consistent.
- **§3.5 ✅ M1 line**, clause by clause: "verifies the `.sig` over the raw bytes against the environment's trusted keys (§7) before inflating anything" — `install.ts:150–272` runs before `readTarGz` at `:277`. "re-verifies every file against `integrity`" — `:339` `verifyIntegrity` (mismatch, missing, undeclared each refused). "materializes to `OS_HOME/plugins/env/id/version/`" — `pluginInstallDir` (`plugin-installation-store.ts:8`). "records the install in a local store (the stand-in for the §3.8 row)" — `:393–408`; the store header L17–21 says exactly that. "`--trust-unsigned` admits only an unsigned artifact, loudly" — `:196–218` (a present signature is always verified, `printStep` says the flag has no effect) and `:320–325` `printWarningToStderr`. "At boot … `os serve` re-verifies each install (artifact sha, signature, byte-equal tree), dispatches on the tier (§3.6) and hands what passed to `kernel.use`, which orders dependencies" — `serve.ts:13` imports `registerInstalledPlugins`; loader checks 2, 3 (`:322–348`, before `readTarGz` at `:353`), 4 (`:350–389`), 5 (`:392`); `installed-plugins-boot.ts:131` `kernel.use`, header L27–28 "dependency order and health checks are the kernel's". "`os plugin disable` / `enable` use the package disable-state store" — `disable.ts` header L7–9, `installedPluginDisabledIds` / `setInstalledPluginDisabled`. "`uninstall` takes effect at the next boot" — `uninstall.ts` header L6–12, `markPluginUninstall`; `loadInstalledPlugins:668–691` `finishUninstall`. "Still open: … (objectstack#27570)" — open, parked. **Holds, every clause.** Observation, no finding: an artifact whose manifest carries no `integrity` map installs with the per-file check skipped and reported (`:460–462`); `os plugin build` always writes the map (`:316–317`), so the sentence holds for every built artifact and the signature still covers the bytes.
- **§3.6 v2 paragraph.** "since M1 the boot-time loader dispatches on an installed plugin's tier (`dispatchPluginRuntime`): `node` is imported in process, `sandbox` / `worker` and an undeclared tier are refused by name — every plugin that loads today loads in-process … Until M3 nothing loads isolated (those tiers are refused, not confined)" — `installed-plugin-loader.ts:180–200` (`runtime_undeclared` for unset / null / empty, `runtime_not_dispatched` otherwise, no fallback); `manifest.zod.ts:200–212` says the same and that a stack's own `plugins` entry is not dispatched, which "loads in-process" covers. Tried to break it: `install.ts:435` also dispatches at install time (a warning, not a refusal) — the ADR names the loader as the gate, which is where the refusal is; no contradiction. **Holds.**
- **§5 Negative.** "Bundled packaging excludes native addons, and `os plugin build` refuses them; with manifest-deps retired (Q6), a plugin that needs one waits for M3 (§3.3)" — §3.3's own last sentence; `build.ts:303`. **Holds.**
- **§7 dated note** against ruling 6467932167. "`sys_trusted_key` (public keys only, `source: 'local'`), `os plugin keygen` and `os plugin trust add | list | revoke`; install and boot refuse an unknown or revoked key id by name" — `sys-trusted-key.object.ts` (`public_key` SPKI PEM, `source` select `local` / `platform` / `cloud` with `local` the only writer, `status` `active` / `revoked`, revoked never re-activated); the four commands exist with the ruling's semantics (`trust/add.ts` refuses a private-key PEM by name); `install.ts:226–241` `signature_key_untrusted` / `signature_key_revoked`; loader `:325–330` the same two. **Holds.** **Should-fix (the one finding of substance):** "Rotation policy and the `platform` / `cloud` sources stay M3" copies the ruling's ordering sentence, but the ruling's own body places the `cloud` rows in M2 ("M2's chain is root key → platform counter-signature → publisher key, cached as `source: 'cloud'` rows in this same store"), the object's docblock written under that ruling says "`platform` and `cloud` for the keys M2 / M3 cache from that chain", and the ADR's own §3.5 M2 bullet has the download route serving the artifact "with publisher + platform signatures" — which needs those rows. The note should say what the ruling's body and the code say: rotation policy M3; `platform` / `cloud` rows reserved, written by the M2 chain (`cloud`) and M3. A phasing label on unbuilt work, so not a must-fix; one clause, respin or a follow-up.

**No remaining sentence contradicts the corrected ones** in the as-built layer: the §7 Q8 answer ("boot activation only"), §3.7 "Reversible disable … on next boot", §3.5 step 6 (local store, `package-state-store.ts` pattern), §3.4 L242–245 (download route M2), §3.7 v2 (`SecurePluginContext` M2), §4 Q3 / Q6 / Q8 and the M1 phasing bullet (the plan, kept as the plan) all agree with the new text. The ✅ line's "hot reload was retired with #12587" agrees with §7. **No must-fix.**

**Pre-existing original-design sentences M1 made stale** — not in this diff's hunks, not in the card's eleven, covered by the ADR's own reading rule (L19–20: unmarked text is the original design, *v2* text is as built) and therefore should-fix follow-ups, not blockers; named so the next docs-only PR in this lane takes all of them at once:
1. §3.5 L281–285 "Local-first parity": `os plugin install ./foo.osplugin` "hit[s] a `marketplace/install-local`-style endpoint (inline artifact, register-before-persist per ADR-0016 §9.3)" — as built it is a CLI act under `OS_HOME` with no HTTP surface, persist at install, register at the next boot. Same class as items 9–11.
2. §3.5 step 7 L275 "(or hot, when `hotReloadable`)" — retired (#12587), §7 says boot-only.
3. §3.7 L397 "Supply chain. Lockfile + per-file `integrity`" — no lockfile ships (L142), as the dev observed.
4. §8 References name `{build,sign,publish}.ts` as "the Phase 1 pipeline as built" and nothing of M1: `install.ts`, `keygen.ts`, `trust/*.ts`, `disable.ts`, `enable.ts`, `uninstall.ts`, `installed-plugin-loader.ts`, `plugin-installation-store.ts`, `plugin-artifact-verdict.ts`, `sys-trusted-key.object.ts`.
5. `sys-trusted-key.object.ts:12` and `:41` docblock drift (③) — `domain:server`, one line each.

Summary of findings: must-fix none; should-fix three on this diff (§7 note's M2 / M3 clause; the status line's amendment list; §8 References), five pre-existing follow-ups.
